title: 抽蓄電站電氣控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討水力儲能、可變速機組與抽發模式切換的控制邊界，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore hydraulic storage, variable-speed machines and pumping/generation control boundaries, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。水頭和效率隨工況改變；本課只做離線調度與狀態機分析，不是水輪機現場啟停程序。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Head and efficiency vary with operating point; this is offline dispatch and state-machine analysis, not a field turbine starting procedure.

stages.title: 水能與機組
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成水能與機組；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete water and machinery through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 定義有效庫容：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Define usable reservoir volume: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解定義有效庫容，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand define usable reservoir volume through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 以庫容—水位表裁去不可用水位，重新積分位能。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Trim unusable levels from a volume-elevation table and reintegrate potential energy. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 以庫容—水位表裁去不可用水位，重新積分位能。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Trim unusable levels from a volume-elevation table and reintegrate potential energy. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「定義有效庫容」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把水力儲能、可變速機組與抽發模式切換的控制邊界的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If define usable reservoir volume disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of hydraulic storage, variable-speed machines and pumping/generation control boundaries behind one passing number.

steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for define usable reservoir volume, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 定義有效庫容：原理
knowledge.text: 總庫容不等於可用儲能量，運轉水位上下限限制有效體積。

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：ρ=1,000 kg/m³、有效水量 10⁶ m³、平均水頭 100 m，位能 ρgVH=981 GJ=272.5 MWh。發電效率 90% 時得 245.25 MWh；抽水效率 90% 時需 302.78 MWh，往返效率 81%。 水頭和效率隨工況改變；本課只做離線調度與狀態機分析，不是水輪機現場啟停程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: ρ=1,000 kg/m³, usable volume 10⁶ m³ and mean head 100 m give ρgVH=981 GJ=272.5 MWh. At 90% generating efficiency output is 245.25 MWh; at 90% pumping efficiency input is 302.78 MWh, yielding 81% round-trip efficiency. Head and efficiency vary with operating point; this is offline dispatch and state-machine analysis, not a field turbine starting procedure.

steps.title: 區分固定速與可變速：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Distinguish fixed and variable speed: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解區分固定速與可變速，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand distinguish fixed and variable speed through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「可變速機組提供額外抽水調節自由度，但受水力運轉區限制。」的觀察。在示意泵曲線上標記固定速工作點與可變速範圍。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Variable speed adds pumping control freedom but remains bounded by hydraulic operating regions. Mark fixed-speed points and variable-speed regions on illustrative pump curves. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 在示意泵曲線上標記固定速工作點與可變速範圍。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Mark fixed-speed points and variable-speed regions on illustrative pump curves. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「區分固定速與可變速」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把水力儲能、可變速機組與抽發模式切換的控制邊界的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If distinguish fixed and variable speed disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of hydraulic storage, variable-speed machines and pumping/generation control boundaries behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「區分固定速與可變速」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for distinguish fixed and variable speed, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: ρ=1,000 kg/m³, usable volume 10⁶ m³ and mean head 100 m give ρgVH=981 GJ=272.5 MWh. At 90% generating efficiency output is 245.25 MWh; at 90% pumping efficiency input is 302.78 MWh, yielding 81% round-trip efficiency.
